question: Identify the group of insulators from the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __'**Plastic, wood and rubber**'.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Insulators **are materials that do not have free electrons, therefore they do not conduct electricity.
 
• Some examples of insulators are Sulphur, Mika, and Polythene.
 
• **Plastic, wood, and rubber **don't have free electrons moving around so they can't conduct heat and electricity which gives them the property of good insulators.
 
• Most non-metal materials such as plastic, wood, and rubber are insulators.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Steel **is a conductor because it is an inflexible and highly corrosive metal when exposed to air.
 
• Iron has metallic bonds which are where the electrons are free to move around more than one atom.
 
• This is called delocalization. Because of this,** iron is a good conductor.**
